description: Get a price quote for a token swap without authentication. Shows expected output amount, exchange rate, and route info. No wallet or session required — use this to check prices before committing to a swap. Supported chains: Base, HyperEVM, Monad. Returns both a readable summary and a `quote` object carrying the route's hops, the exact output, the slippage floor and a derived price impact — computed from the tokens' spot prices, not reported by the router, so treat it as an estimate. In a host that renders UI, prefer open_fibx, which shows the route and lets the user swap from it.
name: get_quote
title: Get Swap Quote
